explication: ComfyUI is a modular AI content-creation engine. A user submits a node-graph workflow through the server; the server queues it, the runtime executes graph nodes, models and samplers produce media, and results/progress return through the server. Workflows can use native model families, reusable subgraphs, custom nodes, local files, and optional partner APIs. This map emphasizes runtime paths evidenced by the tree and sampled source; many model-specific implementations are represented by their enclosing directories.
